routingAndData:
REQUEST FLOW
1. src/proxy.ts runs on every page request:
   - Adds a CSP nonce (179-196).
   - Rewrites any 1- or 2-segment path not on the allow list to /_kig/route-guard/not-found (99-152).
   - The allow list is src/lib/generated/validRoutes.json:
     - courses and tabs are read from courses.ts / tabs.ts;
     - lesson ids are the FILES in content/lessons/<course>/ that match /^[a-z0-9-]+$/i;
     - static routes are found by scanning src/app;
     - public files come from a scan of public/.
   - Built by scripts/buildValidRoutes.mjs (COURSES/TABS 66-67, lessons 106-121, static scan 145-178). It aborts the build if a course is missing from getLesson's switch (270-276), if fewer than 1000 lessons are found (259-261), or if a course has content but no ids.
   - `npx next build` does NOT run prebuild (AGENTS.md:120-128).
2. Routes:
   - "/" → src/app/page.tsx
   - "/t/<tab>" → src/app/t/[tab]/page.tsx
   - "/<course>" → src/app/[course]/page.tsx: index groups → formatGroupTitle → CourseDashboard. Script pages that have a main pair are hidden (99-125).
   - "/<course>/<id>" → src/app/[course]/[lesson]/page.tsx
   - "/student/<id>" → src/app/student/[lesson]/page.tsx. The literal folder wins; it gates first, then renders the [course]/[lesson] LessonPage (135-139).
   - Every page renders per request because the layout reads headers for the nonce (layout.tsx:80). dynamicParams=false is therefore inert; the proxy is the only 404 guard.
3. Lesson JSON is loaded on the SERVER only:
   - getLesson() (content.ts:71-104) does fs.readFileSync + JSON.parse with an in-memory cache (22-36). content/ is traced into the server bundle.
   - The page computes prev/next/pair from the course index (content.ts:124-163). Pairing: main "X" ↔ script "X-N"; GRAMMAR I even ↔ odd by number.
   - It checks access BEFORE building the body (page.tsx:151-194), then passes blocks and pairBlocks as props to a "use client" view. For DIRECT_VIEW_COURSES this happens directly in page.tsx:385-439 (BUG-023). Otherwise it goes through LessonBody.tsx, whose views are next/dynamic (23-58).
   - The page also builds the top-player sentence list with extractSentencesForAudio (src/lib/lessonAudioText.ts:39-153), wrapped in lessonSpeechForm (page.tsx:265-277).

DATA MODEL (src/lib/types.ts)
- Course index content/courses/<slug>.json: {course, tab, lessonCount, groups:[{title|label, lessons:[ids]}], lessons: LessonSummary[] (types.ts:225-237)}.
  - Array order = prev/next order.
  - The STUDENT index uses group "title"; formatGroupTitle is fed g.label || g.title ([course]/page.tsx:118).
- Lesson file content/lessons/<slug>/<id>.json, type Lesson (types.ts:173-215):
  - id, course, series, variant ("main" | "script"), pairId (ignored at runtime), title, label, menuLabel, unit, part, order, audio[] {src, legacySrc, autoplay, label?}, video[], blocks[], legacyPath, legacyEncoding.
  - Optional: chunkDrills, readingSentences, readingVocabulary.
- Block union (types.ts:114-132):
  - heading{text}, instruction{text}, hints{text}
  - sentences{items: SentenceItem[]}, where SentenceItem = {n, text, alternatives?} (134-143)
  - paragraph{text, lang?: en|ko|zh}
  - choice{options} and dictation{rows}: legacy answer-form remnants that the current views ignore
  - wordgrid{rows}
  - There is NO block for grammar explanations, tables or typed exercises. GRAMMAR I 07강 fakes a rule Q&A from instruction lines (GrammarLearningView.tsx:145-166).

HOW A NEW COURSE FOLDER PLUGS IN
1. Add the COURSES entry, content/courses/<slug>.json and content/lessons/<slug>/*.json.
2. Add `case "<slug>"` to getLesson (content.ts:76-100). buildValidRoutes fails without it.
3. Choose a view:
   - (a) Add the slug to DIRECT_VIEW_COURSES (page.tsx:55) AND give it an explicit branch in the ternary at 397-438. The ternary's final else renders StudentLearningView, so a course without its own branch silently gets the STUDENT view.
   - (b) Also add a branch to LessonBody.tsx:121-231. The audit tool check-unreached-data.cjs parses LessonBody (110-146) and throws when a course has no view there (228).
4. Run node scripts/buildValidRoutes.mjs.
5. A dedicated route folder src/app/<slug>/[lesson] is only needed for custom gating, like STUDENT's sequential unlock.
6. Ids must match /^[a-z0-9-]+$/i and are sorted from files, not from the index.
7. A "main" / "<id>-N" script pair gives a second file for free: this is how GRAMMAR II stores English main plus Korean "-1".
gatingAndLicense:
SERVER-SIDE GATE (KIG-001) — the real protection
- src/app/[course]/[lesson]/page.tsx:151-194 decides BEFORE any body data is built:
  - Free lesson → open.
  - Otherwise it verifies the httpOnly cookie kig_license_session (verifyLicenseSessionToken, src/lib/licenseSession.ts:52-72): signed token, device registered, not revoked, not expired (the expiry is fixed at first registration, SEC-01).
  - A denied request renders only <LessonPaywall>, so no lesson text reaches the RSC payload.
- Plan rule (page.tsx:167-169): isStudentOnlyPlan (plan starts with "STU", src/lib/license.ts:79-82) opens only course === "student". 1M, 1Y and LIFE open every course.
- generateMetadata marks every non-free lesson robots noindex,follow (page.tsx:105-110).

FREE PREVIEW
- FREE_PREVIEW_LESSON_IDS, license.ts:120-133: student s1-1, s1-2; phonics mv1-01, 02; grammar1 gh1-006..009 with -1/-2 (12 ids); grammar2 gh2-007, 007-1, 008, 008-1; ld d001, 002 (+-1); reading pr001, 002 (+-1); cnn 2.
- isFreePreviewLesson (154-173) also strips trailing -N suffixes, so a free lesson's media files resolve.
- The dashboard and the client use a POSITIONAL rule instead (sectionIndex === 0 && lessonIndex < 2) when given indexes: CourseDashboard.tsx:491-492, LicenseProvider.tsx:317. The id list and the first two cards of section 1 must agree.
- The same list drives the sitemap, the free clip keys and the free media keys.

LICENSE TYPES (license.ts:11-18, 85-110; serverLicense.ts:64-72, 95-100; api/admin/generate/route.ts:20-28; admin UI admin/license/page.tsx:544-584)
- 1M: 30 days, all-pass.
- 1Y: 365 days, all-pass.
- LIFE: lifetime, all-pass, and every STUDENT chapter open.
- STU1M, STU1Y, STU: STUDENT-only, periods as above.
- STULIFE: lifetime, STUDENT-only.
- Key format KIG-<plan>-<16hex>-<16hex HMAC>. Default 2 devices (maximum 10). calculateExpiry is duplicated in license.ts and serverLicense.ts.

SEQUENTIAL CHAPTER UNLOCK (STUDENT only)
- Rule, in src/app/student/[lesson]/page.tsx:95-133: s1-1 and s1-2 are free. LIFE opens everything. EVERY other plan, including 1M/1Y all-pass and STULIFE, sees a lesson only if its chapter ≤ unlockedThrough. Otherwise the paywall shows lockReason "progress" (LessonPaywall.tsx:40-52, 97-103).
- Unlock math (src/lib/studentProgress.ts:261-294): a chapter is complete when completed ≥ ceil(0.8·n) AND its last lesson is completed. unlockedThrough never decreases.
- Server guards:
  - RE-010: only reachable chapters are accepted (336-389).
  - Ids must match s1..s20 (156, 173).
  - isStudentLessonUnlocked (441-449) hard-codes s1-1/s1-2 and a maximum of 20 chapters (184).
- Client mirrors:
  - LicenseProvider.isUnlocked (326-330)
  - CourseDashboard (397-407, 443-466, 493)
  - /api/student/chapter-audio (chapter 1..20, ch>1 needs a licence, sequential check 48-56)
  - StudentLearningView completion needs ≥1 practised sentence (480)
- The STUDENT progression commit d57e728 touched 22 files.

MEDIA GATE — src/lib/mediaAccess.ts, route handler src/lib/mediaRoute.ts
- /audio/<course>/<file> is allowed only for folders in FOLDER_TO_COURSE (55-63). Free objects must be exact keys in freeMediaKeys.json (freeMedia.ts). Otherwise a session is needed, and STU plans get only the student folder (110-115).
- /audio/azure-ava/v1/<hash>.mp3 is open when the key is in freeSpeechKeys.json; otherwise ANY valid licence session gets it, because a hash carries no course (84-92).
- Denied → 403 no-store. Free → private, max-age=1y, immutable. Licensed → private, max-age=3600 (mediaRoute.ts:39-45, 110-115).

WHAT A NEW COURSE MUST DO TO STAY PROTECTED
1. Render through [course]/[lesson] so it gets the gate for free, or copy the gate exactly into a custom route.
2. Add FREE_PREVIEW_LESSON_IDS["<slug>"] matching the first two cards of section 1.
3. Add the slug to LicenseProvider SERVER_GATED_LESSON_PATH (41-42). Without it there is no reload after activation and the server paywall stays on screen.
4. Add FOLDER_TO_COURSE only if the course ships its own /audio/<slug>/ files; generated clips do not need it.
5. Never import an all-lessons JSON into a client module (ISS-00, src/lib/readingUtils.ts:1-18). Pass one lesson's data as props after the gate.
6. Add the slug to paidLeakCheck/search-index handling (see publicFilesAndSearch).
7. Make the STUDENT-only plan decision consistently in all its copies:
   - page.tsx:167-169
   - mediaAccess.ts:114
   - LicenseProvider.tsx:333-335 and 100
   - CourseDashboard.tsx:187-188
   - LessonPaywall copy
   Whether a STUDENT pass should include a STUDENT companion course is a pricing decision for the owner. Today the new course would be all-pass only.
8. If the course wants sequential unlock, studentProgress.ts must be generalized; its regexes and the 20-chapter limit are STUDENT-only.
audioPipeline:
KEY
- unifiedSpeechKey(text), src/lib/unifiedSpeech.ts:21-35:
  - normalizeUnifiedSpeechText (4-15): "/"→space, strips [..], "::", "--", "…", "|"→", ", empty "()", collapses spaces.
  - Then two 32-bit hashes, giving "<len36>-<16hex>". URL /audio/azure-ava/v1/<key>.mp3 (unifiedSpeechPath 37-39).
  - The key covers the TEXT ONLY: no course, voice or language.
  - The generator keeps an identical copy (scripts/generate-azure-ava.mjs:53-78). speech.ts cleanText = normalize(vocaSpeechForm(text)) (512-514).
  - Curly vs straight apostrophes and quotes are NOT normalized, so they give different keys.

WHAT GETS SPOKEN — one definition, scripts/lib/spoken-texts.cjs
- SPOKEN_COURSES at 39 (hard-coded six courses). spokenTexts() per course at 85-128:
  - Top player: extractSentencesForAudio. For STUDENT only when the lesson has exactly one audio file (96-101).
  - STUDENT: English items spoken via firstSlashAlternative + lessonSpeechForm, AND Korean paragraph lines (102-104). STUDENT is the ONLY course that speaks Korean.
  - GRAMMAR: English items of the page and its pair, cleaned (105-106). Alternatives are never spoken.
  - LD, READING and VOCA have their own branches.
- speechFormFor (84): STUDENT → firstSlashAlternative, phonics → vocaWordSpeech.
- Per-page spoken forms: src/lib/lessonSpeechForm.ts. Romanized Korean words get an IPA tag, e.g. "Seoul ⟨ˈsʌˌul⟩" (table 46-89, pages 92-135, function 162-168), so the SAME English voice reads them (owner's choice "라", 2026-09-26). The generator turns tags into <phoneme> (generate-azure-ava.mjs:270-301).
- A sentence with Hangul inside English gets <lang xml:lang="ko-KR"> runs (languageRuns 240-264). The owner judged that switch "엉망".

GENERATION — scripts/generate-azure-ava.mjs
- Voice en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural (12), mp3 24k/48kbps (13).
- Reads .env.local itself without printing values (24-35).
- Lists R2 audio/azure-ava/v1/ first (130-160). With no R2 credentials it STOPS before calling Azure unless given --dry-run or --allow-local-only (519-540).
- collectTexts (165-229): loads the app's own functions by transpiling src/lib modules and walks only routed ids from validRoutes.json. It throws if validRoutes lacks a SPOKEN_COURSES course (206).
- pending = keys neither on local disk nor in R2 (564-566). The free tier is 500,000 characters/month (569-571). Single requests (concurrency 3) or --batch (Azure batch synthesis, 406-496).
- Output goes to public/audio/azure-ava/v1, which is gitignored (.gitignore:57 per AGENTS.md).

UPLOAD — scripts/upload-azure-ava-r2.mjs
- SigV4 PUT of every local mp3 not in the checkpoint .r2-uploaded.json (93-121, 148-203); concurrency 16.
- Release order (AGENTS.md:95-103): generate → upload to R2 → push. Otherwise a new sentence ships with a silent button.

RUNTIME PLAYBACK — src/lib/speech.ts
- speakText (1029-1043) and playSentenceQueue (1125-1210) call speakWithToken (971-1019).
- speakWithToken first tries playUnifiedClip (766-852): a same-origin shared <audio> plays the Ava clip through /audio/[...path]/route.ts → mediaRoute → R2.
- On error it falls back to browser speechSynthesis (856-939, 1.5 s watchdog), then to the stream engine, which re-requests the SAME clip (719-763).
- In-app browsers such as KakaoTalk use the stream engine. There is no third-party TTS.
- The top AudioPlayer is always in TTS mode outside CNN (AudioPlayer.tsx:63). The original MP3s in lesson.audio[] are never requested; ~3,187 recordings are kept in storage on the owner's decision.

FREE VS PAID CLIPS
- scripts/buildFreeSpeechKeys.mjs (109-126) runs spokenTexts over FREE_PREVIEW_LESSON_IDS (minus cnn) → src/lib/generated/freeSpeechKeys.json: 264 keys from 28 lessons. Assertions: ≥20 lessons, 200–5000 keys (137-142).
- A free lesson's pair must also be free (122).
- Every other clip needs a licence session of any plan (mediaAccess.ts:87-92).
- Also writes freeMediaKeys.json: 38 exact /audio and /video keys (144-163).

CAN SENTENCES IDENTICAL TO STUDENT SENTENCES REUSE CLIPS? YES, when the spoken string is identical after the page's speech-form functions. No new synthesis and no upload is needed; the generator's pending filter skips them automatically.
- Measured offline with node, using the repo's own unifiedSpeech, listeningUtils and lessonSpeechForm:
  - STUDENT speaks 828 distinct clip keys (406 Korean-only; 42,608 characters). All 828 are in the main checkout's local clip folder (52,596 files); R2 was not queried.
  - The Pass-Off Grammar PDFs have 264 lines ending in "(N과)". 62 are STUDENT sentences (loose match) and every chapter tag agrees with the STUDENT chapter. 52 of them would request the EXACT key STUDENT already requests, as written (book 1: 22, book 2: 10, book 3: 20).
- The rest fail because:
  - (a) STUDENT pages with romanized Korean words are tagged per page ("student/s1-2" → Hong Gil Dong/Seoul). A new page needs its own KOREAN_WORD_PAGES entry, or it requests an untagged key.
  - (b) Slashed alternatives are spoken in their first form only for STUDENT.
  - (c) Apostrophe style differs.
- Access: a reused paid STUDENT clip serves any licensed user.
- Making a new course's free preview lesson speak a paid STUDENT sentence adds that clip to the public free list. That sentence becomes public (text and audio).

RULES
- Normalize (324-340): lowercase; ’‘ → ' and “”„ → "; punctuation stripped.
- Contractions are expanded on BOTH sides (CONTRACTIONS 52-64: can't/cannot → can not, won't, n't, I'm, 're, 've, 'll, pronoun+'s, let's).
- 'd is resolved as would or had by the next word (81-138; D_SKIP, D_EITHER, D_HAD, D_ED_BASE). The learner's ambiguous 'd is tried both ways (450-454).
- gradeAnswer (439-462) takes the better of the expanded pass and a literal pass. The literal pass keeps typo-inside-contraction partial credit.
- exact: identical after normalization, or differs only in spacing (gradeSpacingOnly 483-492). Meaning-changing joins (maybe / may be, everyday / every day …, 470-475) are partial instead.
- partial (494-537), all of these must hold:
  - more than one word;
  - LCS ≥ 70% of model words, in order;
  - length ≤ 1.15× the model (MAX_ANSWER_LEN_RATIO 45; exactly one surplus non-negating function word is allowed);
  - every mismatched word pair is function word ↔ function word (FUNCTION_WORDS 145-161), or a near-miss spelling: edit distance ≤ 1, ≤ 2 for words of ≥ 8 letters, or the same 4–5 letter stem (looksLikeSameWord 374-382).
- Negation flip → incorrect (flipsNegation 262-311):
  - An odd count of unmatched negators (NEGATORS 191, including "unless" and cannot) flips the meaning.
  - Question tags and an answering "No," are ignored.
  - "or not", "no matter", "no sooner" and "no doubt" are ignored.
  - af6a226 (2026-09-25, owner decision): a partial negation "not + every/everyone/everybody/everything/all/both/always" against a total negator "no/none/nobody/nothing/neither/never/noone/nowhere" is incorrect (PARTIAL_AFTER_NOT and TOTAL_NEGATORS 197-198, 302-307). Example: "No boy lost his life" against "Not every boy …" now scores 0.
- Prefix opposites (im/in/il/ir/un/dis/non, isPrefixedOpposite 368-371) → incorrect, owner decision "뜻이 반대면 0점".
- gradeAgainstReferences (540-549): the best grade across model plus alternatives.
